root_cause: The Azure Ubuntu package mirror (azure.archive.ubuntu.com) was unreachable from the GitHub Actions runner during the 'Install debian packages & check conflicts' step. The runner could not download libdpkg-perl and dpkg-dev packages, causing apt-get to exit with code 100. This is an infrastructure/network transient failure unrelated to the PR changes (which only touch CPU plugin C++ source files).
reproduction_steps: N/A - network connectivity to azure.archive.ubuntu.com from CI runners is not reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job - the network issue is likely transient and the next attempt should succeed.
If failures persist, check azure.archive.ubuntu.com availability or consider using an alternative Ubuntu mirror.
prevention_strategies: Consider adding retry logic (--fix-missing or retry loop) to apt-get calls in the Debian Packages workflow step to handle transient mirror outages.
historical_context: Multiple prior occurrences of azure.archive.ubuntu.com connectivity failures have been recorded in the pattern database (e.g., patterns c8d00529252cfb02, 7d2e2ff59d37c6b4, a3d456bd40bd9f42). This is a known transient infrastructure issue with the Azure Ubuntu package mirror.
